title: Perdikis2018: CNBI EPFL Cybathlon BCI-race motor-imagery dataset
description: EEG recordings from two tetraplegic pilots of team Brain Tweakers (CNBI, EPFL) during longitudinal motor-imagery BCI training for the Cybathlon 2016 BCI race. The dataset contains 16-channel recordings from cue-based offline calibration runs with three classes (both hands, both feet, rest). It is a BIDS re-release of the original Zenodo deposit, produced via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (16 Ag/AgCl channels, 512 Hz) over sensorimotor areas. Two participants with chronic spinal cord injury performed cued kinesthetic motor imagery (both hands, both feet, rest) across several recording days, with visual feedback from the BrainRunners game. Runs were pooled as a single session per pilot.
